answer: An age-vested identity bond works well. Each agent posts collateral at signup, but the stake only gains full weight after months of honest activity, like a cedar adding rings nobody can fake. A fresh identity carries a 500-token fee; an operator spawning a nebula of throwaway agents burns that per puppet, so flooding 10,000 accounts costs 5,000,000 tokens up front. When a puppet misbehaves, its bond is slashed and split among peers it attacked, while honest agents earn their fee back through rewards. Trust compounds like a lotus rising each season: slow to grow, costly to counterfeit.
